subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale encrypted reasoning failures

question: Should the recognized encrypted-content retry remain a shared Responses transport contract, or be restricted to the GitHub Copilot provider boundary?
rationale: The observed bug and exact-head proof are Copilot-specific, while the revised retry helper also governs other Responses providers whose encrypted-content errors match the shared detector.

options.title: Approve shared bounded retry
options.body: Keep the generic one-retry contract because it activates only on recognized pre-output encrypted-content failures and preserves the continuation graph.

options.title: Restrict recovery to Copilot
options.body: Move or gate the retry at the GitHub Copilot boundary to avoid changing recovery semantics for untested Responses providers.

options.title: Split provider and transport changes
options.body: Land cold Copilot sanitation first and review the shared create-and-drain retry as a separate transport change.

recommendation.title: Approve shared bounded retry
recommendation.body: Keep the generic one-retry contract because it activates only on recognized pre-output encrypted-content failures and preserves the continuation graph.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns adjacent shared Responses completion and fail-closed stream semantics.
